purpose: Canonical relationship layer for Partner Customization skill availability. This layer supplements, but does not duplicate, the canonical Future Warrior/CaC skill corpus.
identity_rule: skill_id is always the canonical skill identity; partner_name is the character/custom-partner endpoint identity. Do not create a second skill record for partner availability when the skill already exists canonically.
evidence_rule: Every relationship must cite repository evidence. Absence from this index must not be interpreted as proof that a partner cannot use a skill.

relationships.evidence_note: Current Xenoverse 2 evidence explicitly states Bardock custom-partner availability after Partner Customization purchase.
Current Xenoverse 2 evidence explicitly states Turles custom-partner availability after Partner Customization purchase.
Current Xenoverse 2 evidence explicitly identifies Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed) as using Reverse Mabakusenko via Partner Customization.

The live Batch 473 artifact is returned by an exact Partner Customization + skill_id search, but the indexed fragment does not expose an explicit partner assignment. This is retained as a discovery marker only and is not counted as a confirmed partner/character pair.

excluded_candidates.reason: The current corpus has no canonical skill-dual-masenko record; partner/custom availability alone is not sufficient to create a duplicate or new canonical record.
